title: Praying for souls and the candle dream
summary: She prayed for priests and souls and dreamed about lighting candles, and her aunt appeared in chains.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Mary, when you began praying, what were some of the things that happened?

Well, I don't know, I prayed so very hard. One thing I was very happy that I became Catholic because their liturgy and what they preach teach you about everyday life if you catch on to it. You're never unhappy if you pay attention to what you read and what's said in the Gospels. One thing that happened with me when I was praying, I remember reading little pamphlets - every thing in the church I'd sit and read it and I never studied so hard in all my life, as far as reading. I'd pray for the souls in purgatory. You know what actually happened with me, I prayed so hard for priests and later on a lot of them came up with me. I don't know why I was praying so hard for them but most of my prayers - and I used to light candles for them in the church, you know. I felt that lighting a candle was not the candle itself God was doing the work and I'd light candles just for the days that I was doing a Novena. I had a dream once that I was worried about lighting a candle. I had a dream that Buck Clayton and all of them were sitting up in the balcony and God showed me that it was just a light that was being shined down on them for their soul and all that and it wasn't superstition to fool around with candles. I used to pray so hard for the souls and if anybody died till when anyone died, they actually came to the house. I had an aunt that died and she was in chains. I spoke to her and asked her and she came back to me in a dream and said to me
